t_refunds.text: Refunds — failed refunds first, then look up one order

s_refunds.text:
The Refunds page is for its own work only: the failed-refunds queue and looking up a code. Refunding from an order happens in the order workspace.

Refunds are per order: there is no list of all refunds (Needs API). The one work queue, failed refunds from listRefunds with state Failed, sits first. Each row names its order by id until the code loads; Issue a new refund and Open order are in the row's Actions menu. A row stays after a replacement is issued, since a Refund has no replaced-by link (Needs API).

Nothing to refund is caught at lookup: nothing captured yet, rejected, cancelled before acceptance, payment failed, or already fully refunded.

A lookup that fails is never shown as 'no order'. A missing halal field shows plain text on the order card, never a badge.

t_refundform.text: Refund form — scope, reason, evidence, confirm

s_refundform.text:
Reasons follow the scope. Whole order: order-level reasons. Selected items adds Item missing and Wrong item. Fees only: Late delivery, Platform error, Pricing error. Disputed orders add Before a chargeback (admin only); the reason is what went wrong, never Dispute resolution.

Halal concern is offered to staff for a customer's halal complaint, with evidence. Owner decision (round 2): the restaurant pays the item's net price only when the evidence backs the concern up; otherwise it is goodwill paid by the platform. Staff record which in the form; that field, and the server honouring it, are Needs API (today the server charges the restaurant whatever is attached). Packaging tamper isn't offered at launch: with no package seal, nobody can tell whether the restaurant or the delivery opened it.

The form, the review step and the result all live in one in-page panel in the order workspace, in place of More detail; there is no confirm dialog, and Done on a result closes the panel.

Whole order is off on any order that already has a live refund, until the API defines what it does there. Contract gaps, drawn as Needs API: the staff refund route has no Fees only scope and no evidence ids; the general refund route has both but no case id or reason text, so Fees only is drawn off with its tag. Uploads have no purpose for refund evidence, so Add photos is off and the review step says evidence isn't sent.

s_refundresults.text:
202 is a first-class result, not a toast. Each 409 names what happened and the next step. Results announce one line to screen readers and move focus to the panel heading.

The server's amount is never explained by the page; a breakdown is Needs API.

Recovery stays on the same order: after a conflict, Switch to selected items keeps the draft on that order with the refund that landed listed; Reload the order reloads that order.
